title: Filming: Love Awake by Wings | 1979
content:
Wings filmed a promotional clip for the Back To The Egg song ‘Love Awake’ on 14 June 1979.

The shoot took place at Lympne Castle in Kent. It was directed by Keith ‘Keef’ McMillan, who shot promos for several other songs from the Back To The Egg album in the same week.

The video involved Wings miming to ‘Love Awake’ before an open fire in the kitchen of the castle.
